explanation: For each position i, choose uniformly among positions i through n-1 and exchange the chosen value into position i.
correctness: At position i each remaining occurrence has probability 1/(n-i) of being selected. Multiplying conditional probabilities gives 1/n! for each full occurrence permutation.
walkthrough: Starting with [4,8,1], position 0 chooses uniformly among all three occurrences. If it selects index 2, the array becomes [1,8,4]. Position 1 then chooses index 1 or 2 equally, producing [1,8,4] or [1,4,8]. Each full three-element permutation has probability 1/(3*2)=1/6. The judge returns true when these distribution and in-place properties hold.
